steps.title: Get claim-to-DeepProbLog compilation working
steps.status: comparison completed; common representation and semantic review still in progress

items.text: Research existing syntax-to-logic, SRL, AMR and recent clause-level logical-form generation methods
Run syntax/SRL rules, pretrained AMR, direct neural graphs and syntax/SRL-assisted neural graphs on the same 79 development claims and 21 controls
Inspect generated graphs and compiled predicates; revise source-scope handling where trained SRL and AMR use different argument slots
Validate generated Prolog syntax and execute a bounded compilation diagnostic in DeepProbLog, without media verification
Finish a reviewed reference set for 25 selected real claims and 21 controls; check roles, modifiers, shared identity, source scope, polarity and tense separately
Freeze a common logical-form schema: predicate signatures and senses, recursive source content, noun-phrase decomposition, and one temporal interface
Fix shared translation defects and explicit refusals; retain trained SRL and pretrained AMR as the two low-cost baselines
Test one small clause-level logical-form generator with deterministic serialization; compare text-only and SRL assistance on the same references
Freeze the parser/compiler and evaluate compilation plus meaning preservation on unseen source videos before more media verification

steps.note: Immediate priority confirmed by user: compilation first. New source: compilation_methods_20261028. Higher acceptance is not semantic accuracy: SRL retains opaque phrases; AMR loses some details; prompted 8B graphs can invent polarity or roles. Ten examples have assistant qualitative reviews; the full reference review is pending. Planning proposal: one or two focused working days, then choose a bounded supported fragment. No new relation model was trained.

items.text: Check paraphrases and active/passive forms for equivalent meaning

Inspect incomplete, completed and interrupted events; progressive evidence must not automatically certify completion
Do not assume a tense swap makes a negative: review the reference time, event identity and phases shown in the clip
Develop fixes on development sources, then freeze the compiler for evaluation on separate sources

steps.note: Historical tests use hand-authored inputs; the new regression tests also cover trained-SRL written-content scope, inverse AMR roles, shared variables, branch-local quantifiers and explicit refusals. Automatic parsing is assessed separately. New temporal atoms are compilation outputs and are not connected to the older interval-checking interface.
